title: Andy Mukherjee: the success of SpaceX’s IPO may have eased the path for Jio Platforms to go public
description: With investors having rushed for Elon Musk's mega-IPO, market appetite may be strong for tech-adjacent offerings like Jio too. Plus, increased liquidity in the system as a result of RBI’s dollar-luring measures could make conditions easier for big-ticket IPOs in India.
